# FBi Buildings

> > Custom post-frame pole barns and agricultural buildings designed and built across the Midwest since 1958.

FBi Buildings specializes in designing, building, and renovating custom pole barns and post-frame structures for residential, commercial, agricultural, and equestrian applications. The company serves Illinois, Indiana, Michigan, Ohio, Iowa, and Missouri with both turnkey construction and DIY kit options.

## Key Topics

- post-frame construction
- pole barns
- post-frame buildings

## Design & Customization

- [Design Your Own Pole Barn](https://www.fbibuildings.com/getting-started/design-your-own): 3D online tool to design and visualize custom pole barns
- [Request a Quote](https://www.fbibuildings.com/request-a-quote): Quote request form for pole barn and post-frame building estimates
- [Pole Barn Kits](https://www.fbibuildings.com/pole-barn-kits): DIY pole barn kits with material packages and pre-designed sizes

## Building Types & Solutions

- [Farm Buildings](https://www.fbibuildings.com/farm-buildings): Custom agricultural pole barns including farm shops and storage
- [Residential Buildings](https://www.fbibuildings.com/residential-buildings): Custom residential pole barns for garages, workshops, RV storage
- [Commercial Buildings](https://www.fbibuildings.com/commercial-buildings): Commercial pole barns for warehouses, retail, and municipal use
- [Barndominiums](https://www.fbibuildings.com/barndominiums): Barndominiums and shouse pole barn homes with post-frame construction
- [Horse Barns](https://www.fbibuildings.com/horse-barns): Custom horse barns, stables, and equestrian facilities

- [Building Renovations](https://www.fbibuildings.com/buildings/building-renovations): Case studies on pole barn renovation and reskin projects
